rounds.label: LoRA base (no DPO)
rounds.notes: Domain-adapted LoRA, no preference alignment. Unfiltered real-only baseline.

rounds.label: DiffusionDPO round 1
rounds.notes: First DPO pass. Motion smoothness shows largest gain (LPIPS -5%). Prompt adherence (CLIP) +4.1%.

rounds.label: DiffusionDPO round 2
rounds.notes: Compounding improvement. Reward score plateaus more slowly than CLIP—suggests reward model captures dimensions CLIP misses (motion consistency, background stability).

rounds.label: DiffusionDPO round 3
rounds.notes: Round 3 wins are concentrated in motion quality (smoother trajectories) and background consistency. CLIP improvement slows relative to rounds 1-2—prompt adherence near ceiling for this prompt distribution.

reward_signal_ablation.description: Win rate at round 3 vs baseline, varying reward signal composition
reward_signal_ablation.finding: Composite reward (CLIP + optical flow + temporal LPIPS equally weighted) outperforms any single signal. CLIP-only DPO slightly improves prompt adherence but hurts motion; flow-only improves motion at the cost of prompt fidelity. The composite captures both dimensions.

lora_rank_sensitivity.description: Round 3 win rate vs baseline at different LoRA ranks
lora_rank_sensitivity.finding: r=16 is the knee of the curve: +4.6pp win rate vs r=8 at the cost of 4x parameters. r=32 shows no further gain.
